about: LiteLLM's per-session iteration limiter as it runs with Redis off: the in-memory get and set awaited with nothing suspending between them

lines: # gdp: law a call is admitted only while its session is below max_iterations: _get_session_id(...) is not None and _get_max_iterations(...) is not None and not failed implies old(internal_usage_cache[_get_session_id(...)]) < _get_max_iterations(...)

# gdp: law every call of a limited session counts one, refused or not: _get_session_id(...) is not None and _get_max_iterations(...) is not None implies internal_usage_cache[_get_session_id(...)] == old(internal_usage_cache[_get_session_id(...)]) + 1
